_about: W. A. Clouston's books of popular tales: The Book of Noodles (Glasgow, March 1888), the stories of simpletons traced across countries; A Group of Eastern Romances and Stories (MDCCCLXXXIX), which he compiled from Edward Rehatsek's translations from the Persian and others' from the Tamil and Urdu; and The Bakhtyār Nāma (MDCCCLXXXIII), Sir William Ouseley's translation, which he edited. His essays and wise sayings are not taken. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
